milestone.describes: Level 1 of the free pack is being played: the glass tower stands over the Score/Lives HUD, and tapping blocks removes them so the tower settles and the HUD counts.

steps.expect: The title menu, with GLASS TOWER GAME as the first entry.
The game submenu, with NEW GAME on it.
Level 1: the tower of blocks drawn over the Score/Lives HUD.
The tapped block disappears, the blocks above it topple and settle, and the HUD changes — Score up for a plain block, Lives down with a red -10 popup for a red one.
A second block removed and more physics: the loop is running, which is the milestone.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window.

The tower layout is fixed for a given pack level, but blocks move as earlier ones are removed, so the two block taps aim at the lower course where something is still standing. If a block tap lands on empty space nothing happens and nothing breaks — tap where a block is instead of expecting these exact points to stay occupied.

An earlier account in the app note reaches SELECT LEVEL PACK by a different path and picks the free pack at (160, 165). The route here is the one recorded with the 3-star milestone; try (160, 165) if the free-pack tap stops working.
